Write one result as a sentence

Source: R/report.R
cr_sentence.Rd

Templates state direction and significance and then the statistics, e.g. "Compared with Control, Gain was associated with higher trust, b = 0.46, 95% CI \[0.04, 0.89\], p = .032." Non-significant results get "did not differ significantly" wording. Words come from the data, so the sentence stays true when results change.

Usage

cr_sentence(
  x,
  dv,
  variable = NULL,
  level = NULL,
  stats = NULL,
  format = c("markdown", "latex", "html", "plain"),
  style = c("apa", "econ"),
  alpha = 0.05,
  subgroup = NULL,
  digits = 2,
  p_digits = 3
)

Arguments

x

A clean_results or cr_tests object.

dv

Outcome name (raw or displayed label).

variable

Predictor or grouping variable, or a coefficient name such as "age". For correlations, the other variable.

level

Factor level as in the data ("LossFraming") or as displayed ("Loss framing"); for contrasts, "Loss vs. Gain" in either form.

stats

Which pieces to include, in order: any of "est", "se", "ci", "test", "p", "es" (effect size). NULL uses the style's default.

format

"markdown" (Quarto/R Markdown), "latex", "html", or "plain" (for pasting into Google Docs or Word).

style

"apa" (italic symbols, no leading zero for p, r) or "econ" (estimate with SE and p in parentheses, leading zeros).

alpha

Threshold for the significance wording.

subgroup

For tests run with by, which subgroup.

digits, p_digits

Decimal places.

Value

A character string.
